articleTitle: Hydrating Dry Skin Without Heavy Occlusives: 5 Alternatives to Slugging
imageHeadline: Hate slugging? You still need occlusion.
imageSubtext: 5 ways to hydrate dry skin without the greasy pillowcase
pinTitle: How to Hydrate Dry Skin Without Heavy Occlusives (Alternatives to Slugging)
pinDescription: Living in a dry climate means your skin needs occlusion—but not the petrolatum that transfers to your pillowcase. Learn which lightweight occlusives actually work, why humectants need backup in low humidity, and how to build a sustainable routine when the air is genuinely arid.

items.label: Layer humectants under lightweight occlusives like squalane
Run a humidifier at 40–50% to reduce water loss overnight
Cleanse once daily and apply products to damp skin

backgroundScene: A bedside table with a small humidifier releasing gentle mist, next to a minimalist bottle of serum and a soft cotton pillowcase in natural morning light
